meta.title: Inspiration
meta.description: Draft the chapter, rewrite it to author requirements, or polish an exact selection using a popup. Whole-chapter rewriting makes two model calls for analysis and rewriting. Edit manually, preview proposals and explicitly approve the changes to keep. Includes chapter-scoped confirmed canon, visible context manifests, revision history and JSON/Markdown export. Follows the DSH default or a separately selected writing model and available reasoning effort; sends selected novel content to that model's provider. Local single-author use only; character budgets are not exact token budgets. Story consistency and literary quality still require human review.
